spanish: Y toda su grasa acercará desde él: la cola y la grasa la cubriente el interior,

findings.issue: מִמֶּנּוּ is a preposition with a 1st common plural suffix; «desde él» is 3rd masculine singular.

notes: The rest of the clause matches the tokens: all his fat, hiphil 3ms bring-near, the tail, and the fat that covers the interior.
